entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:2
segments: Separate three cities; to be cities of refuge on the west side of Jordan, as he already had done on the east side.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:7
segments: Great care should be taken that men do not suffer for that of which they are not guilty.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:12
segments: Deliver him into the hand of the avenger; after he had been proved guilty of murder.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:13
segments:
Shall not pity him; in any such way as to prevent his execution. 
 
If men are proved to be guilty of murder, no pity or compassion should save them from the punishment which God requires to be inflicted on them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:14
segments:
Landmark; that which showed the division line between the property of one man and another. 
 
Every attempt of men to appropriate to themselves what belongs to others is a sin against God, and exposes those who are guilty of it to his wrath.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:15
segments: One witness shall not rise; a man shall not be condemned on the testimony of one witness only.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:19
segments: Do unto him; he shall receive the punishment which he sought to bring on another.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:21
segments: Few crimes are more offensive to God than bearing false witness; and whether false accusers meet due punishment or not in this world, continuing impenitent they will not escape it in the world to come.
